item.title: Two Wendy's coming to Manatee amid nationwide cutback
item.description: Although Wendy’s hasn’t specified which of its 350 restaurants will close as part of a nationwide plan, the fast-food giant announced recently it’s opening two locations in Manatee County this month.A Parrish store on U.S. 301 and a Palmetto store on Moccasin Wallow Road will feature the company’s latest design and décor, according to a release from the developer of the two stores, CASTO, based in Columbus, Ohio. item.title: USF secures $14M in federal funds for community projects
item.description: The University of South Florida will receive $14.05 million in federal funds from a new spending package that will back a number of projects throughout the university system, according to a release. item.title: Allegiant launches flight from SRQ to upstate New York
item.description: Allegiant has launched a new flight from Sarasota-Bradenton International Airport to Frederick Douglass Greater Rochester International Airport (ROC) in Rochester, New York.The route began Feb. 13 and will operate up to three times a week, according to a statement from the Las Vegas-based airline. “We’re thrilled to see Allegiant continue expanding service at SRQ, and this new nonstop route to Rochester, New York, strengthens our connections to the Northeast,” Paul Hoback Jr., president and CEO

item.title: 57 St. Petersburg jobs cut as in-person tolls on Skyway eliminated

item.title: Marine salvage and diving firm opens regional HQ in Pasco
item.description: A Pasco County-based marine services provider specializing in vessel salvage and commercial diving, Isla Maritime, is expanding its operations after opening its new U.S. headquarters in Port Richey this month, according to the Pasco County Economic Development Council. The company purchased a 3,000-square-foot warehouse and office space at 6802 Commerce Ave. in Port Richey to serve as its permanent base on the Gulf Coast, according to a release. item.description: Work has officially begun on the new North Port Emergency Operations Center. item.title: Longboat Key estate, designed by prominent architect, listed for $22M
item.description: A waterfront estate known as the "House of Columns" on Longboat Key has hit the market. Located on almost 5 acres at 6610 Gulf of Mexico Drive, the house encompasses nearly 7,000 square feet. Also included in the listing is 6630 Gulf of Mexico Drive, where the future owners could build a guest house or secondary structure. item.title: Regulators order NJ company to stop issuing auto warranties in Florida
item.description: Florida’s Office of Insurance Regulation has ordered that an automobile extended warranty company stop writing policies in the state while demanding it honor claims from policies already written.The office said in a statement Tuesday that American Dream Auto Protect has been ordered to cease operating here after entering into agreements without a license or approval from the office.Contact information for American Dream and its owner Moshe “Henry” Qubrusi were not immediately available.
